name: auto_addcalender
start: mkdir -p .streamlit && if [ -n "$OPENAI_API_KEY" ]; then umask 077; printf 'OPENAI_API_KEY = "%s"\n' "$OPENAI_API_KEY" > .streamlit/secrets.toml; echo 'Wrote .streamlit/secrets.toml from OPENAI_API_KEY env var'; else echo 'OPENAI_API_KEY not set; .streamlit/secrets.toml not created'; fi
